CustomField.description: Call length shown as minutes and seconds, built from the two duration fields.
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(ISBLANK(Call_Duration_Minutes__c), ISBLANK(Call_Duration_Seconds__c)), "", TEXT(BLANKVALUE(Call_Duration_Minutes__c, 0)) & " min " & TEXT(BLANKVALUE(Call_Duration_Seconds__c, 0)) & " sec")
CustomField.label: Call Duration
